# `kernel/arch/i386/stand` — i386 standalone boot code

## English

This directory contains i386 standalone boot code.

`config.mk` records 12 source file(s) here: `boot.c`, `bootxx.c`, `cga.c`, `conf.c`, `confxx.c`, `fd.c`, `fdbootblk.c`, `kbd.c`, `prf.c`, `srt0.c`, `wd.c`, `wdbootblk.c`.

Subdirectories: `libsa/`, `libsmsa/`.

These `config.mk` lists are reference metadata from the 4.5BSD tree; the BSD45 build scripts (`build_kernel.ps1` / `build_kernel.sh`) select the files that are actually compiled.
